user.title: Connect to Ufanet SmartHome
user.description: Enter the contract login and password used by the Ufanet SmartHome app.

error.unknown: Unexpected response from the service. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Ufanet account is already configured.

init.title: Ufanet Intercom options
init.description: Changes are applied after the integration reloads automatically. YAML values in custom:ufanet-intercom-card override only that card.

data_description.skud_scan_interval_seconds: How often the available intercom/SKUD list is refreshed.
data_description.call_media_refresh_seconds: How long preview/archive media URLs are cached for call history.
data_description.call_lead_seconds: Start archive playback this many seconds before a call.
data_description.archive_default_duration_seconds: Used by HA archive entities and the card unless YAML sets duration.
data_description.archive_default_step_seconds: Used by HA archive entities and the card unless YAML sets step.
data_description.export_auto_cleanup: When disabled, post-export cleanup is skipped; manual cleanup remains available.
data_description.call_autosave_enabled: Automatically export a new call to Home Assistant Media. The pre-call part uses the Archive lead before call option.
data_description.call_autosave_after_seconds: How many seconds after the call timestamp to include in the automatic MP4.
